description: Leads Ops write-smoke and relay evidence. A requested row is the handoff (no run_on, commit or result). A passed or failed row adds run_on (YYYY-MM-DD, ET), commit (git SHA the run used), egress (vps / mac / residential_relay), method (one_shot_run / relay_only_run / relay_read_smoke / prod_mongo_aggregate) and result (the run's JSON plus mongo_writer_results = number of MongoWriter results in writer_results). Validated by scripts/build_recon_matrix.py. Evidence only: it never changes SCRAPER_SOURCE_STATES.

records.label: Lee (FL)
records.command: MONGODB_URI=<prod> python main.py Lee  (copy the final 'Result: {...}' log line), then MONGODB_URI=<prod> python scripts/smoke_evidence_check.py --county Lee --state FL --hours 24
records.expect: Result status ok with a MongoWriter result (new_records + updated_records >= 1); smoke_evidence_check: booking_number_shapes only NNNNNNN, booking_number_duplicates 0, with_booking_date and with_booking_time == rows, with_charges > 0, bond only empty or positive (zero 0), status In Custody / Released, with_mugshot > 0
records.blocked_on: Lee runs every 30 min on the VPS already; if Brendan has not cleared Lee's APE StealthSession / Scrapfly path, record the prod aggregate (method prod_mongo_aggregate) instead of a new one-shot run.

records.label: Charlotte (FL)
records.command: On the home relay, VPN off: CHARLOTTE_EGRESS_MODE=direct python scripts/charlotte_residential_smoke.py
